pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ tíng xíng lìng pángbiān de liǎngzhāng zhǐ chōuchūlái , fàngdào tǎ wéi miànqián .
pairs.english: Nerai drew out two sheets beside the closure order and laid them before Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把停行令旁边的两张纸抽出来，放到塔维面前。

pairs.target: dìyīzhāng huà zhe yìpái tuōzhù zhàndào de tiě zuò .
pairs.english: The first depicted a row of iron supports holding up a raised walkway.
pairs.hanzi: 第一张画着一排托住栈道的铁座。

pairs.target: dìèrzhāng shì tóng yíchù , gé le liùtiān , dìsānzhī tiě zuò de wèizhì dīxiàqù yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The second showed the same place six days later, the third support sitting slightly lower.
pairs.hanzi: 第二张是同一处，隔了六天，第三只铁座的位置低下去一点。

pairs.target: huàtú de rén zài pángbiān biāomíng , shíjī méi dòng , zàizhòng yě méi biàn , xièxiàqù yǐhòu , tiě zuò réng méi huídào yuánchù .
pairs.english: The draughtsperson noted that the stone footing hadn't moved and the load hadn't changed; even after unloading, the support hadn't returned to position.
pairs.hanzi: 画图的人在旁边标明，石基没动，载重也没变，卸下去以后，铁座仍没回到原处。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe nà yìxiǎo duàn chābié .
pairs.english: Tavi stared at the small difference.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着那一小段差别。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào yìdiǎn tiě biànruǎn néng zěnyàng , què hái bùnéng bǎ zhǎng xīnlǐ nà diǎn biànhuà , fàngdà chéng zhěngtiáolù dǐxià de shì . "
pairs.english: He knew what a little softening iron could do, but couldn't yet enlarge the change beneath his palms into something under a whole road.
pairs.hanzi:
他知道一点铁变软能怎样，却还不能把掌心里那点变化，放大成整条路底下的事。
“

pairs.target: nàshí yǒurén shòushāng ma ? " "
pairs.english: “Was anyone hurt then?”
pairs.hanzi:
那时有人受伤吗？”
“

pairs.target: dìyīcì méiyǒu . dìèrcì , yígè tiāo yán de niǔ le jiǎo .
pairs.english: “Not the first time. The second time, a salt carrier twisted an ankle.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次没有。第二次，一个挑盐的扭了脚。

pairs.target: lù bǎn qiàoqǐlái , tā diào le yìzhī kuāng . " nài lěi shuō , "
pairs.english: A road plank tilted up, and he lost a basket,” Nerai said.
pairs.hanzi: 路板翘起来，他掉了一只筐。”奈蕾说，“

pairs.target: nàtiān wǎnshàng , wǒmen bǎ jìnchù de zhùhù dàidào shàngpō huòzhàn .
pairs.english: “That night we brought nearby households up to the freight depot.
pairs.hanzi: 那天晚上，我们把近处的住户带到上坡货栈。

pairs.target: dìèrtiān chá xiàmiàn de jiù zhīxiàn , méi zhǎodào néng fàngxīn duànkāi de dìfāng . "
pairs.english: Next day we inspected the old branch line underneath and couldn't find a place we could safely disconnect.”
pairs.hanzi: 第二天查下面的旧支线，没找到能放心断开的地方。”

pairs.target: zhè shì sānnián qián de jìlù .
pairs.english: The record was three years old.
pairs.hanzi: 这是三年前的记录。

pairs.target: tíng xíng lìng shàng xiě zhe kèhuò zàn zhǐ , zhùhù cóng běipō chūrù , fùchá yǐhòu zài dìng .
pairs.english: The order temporarily halted passenger and freight traffic, directing residents to the north slope pending reassessment.
pairs.hanzi: 停行令上写着客货暂止，住户从北坡出入，复查以后再定。

alignment.english: directing residents to the north slope

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú le liǎngbiàn , cái fāxiàn " zàn " zì hòumiàn bìng méiyǒu yígè rìzi . "
pairs.english: Tavi read it twice before noticing that “temporarily” was followed by no date.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维读了两遍，才发现“暂”字后面并没有一个日子。
“

pairs.target: tāmen jiù zài huòzhàn zhù zhe ? " "
pairs.english: “They stayed in the depot?”
pairs.hanzi:
他们就在货栈住着？”
“

pairs.target: méiyǒu yìzhí zhù . hòulái dàduō huí le wū , zǒu běipō . yě yǒu bānzǒu de . "
pairs.english: “They didn't stay forever. Most later went home and used the north slope. Some moved away.”
pairs.hanzi: 没有一直住。后来大多回了屋，走北坡。也有搬走的。”

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ lìng yìzhāng zhǐ fānchūlái , shàngmiàn suànle ràoxíng de lùchéng .
pairs.english: Nerai turned up another sheet calculating the detour's length.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把另一张纸翻出来，上面算了绕行的路程。

pairs.target: duō chūlái de bùzhǐ shì lù , háiyǒu táijiē .
pairs.english: It added not just distance but steps.
pairs.hanzi: 多出来的不止是路，还有台阶。

pairs.target: tuīchē guò bùliǎo , dé xièchéng xiǎo dān , fēn jǐtàng tiāo guòqù .
pairs.english: Carts couldn't pass: loads had to be divided into small shoulder-pole loads and carried over several trips.
pairs.hanzi: 推车过不了，得卸成小担，分几趟挑过去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe nàxiē shù , hūrán xiǎngdào sè lā wān yíxià xīgài shí zuǐjiǎo de biànhuà . "
pairs.english: Looking at the numbers, Tavi suddenly remembered how Sela's mouth tightened when she bent a knee.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维望着那些数，忽然想到瑟拉弯一下膝盖时嘴角的变化。
“

pairs.target: zhè xiě le duōjiǔ yǐhòu qù fùchá ? "
pairs.english: “Does it say when they would inspect again?”
pairs.hanzi: 这写了多久以后去复查？”

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu zhǐ zhǐ .
pairs.english: Nerai didn't point at the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有指纸。

pairs.target: tā shuō dāngshí yuánběn xiǎng zài rùdōng qián huíqù , hòulái lìng yíduànlù chū liǎo shì , duìwu tiáo zǒu le .
pairs.english: She said they'd intended to return before winter, but trouble on another road had drawn the team away.
pairs.hanzi: 她说当时原本想在入冬前回去，后来另一段路出了事，队伍调走了。

pairs.target: jiǎnchá bèi wǎnghòu pái , yícì , yòu yícì .
pairs.english: The inspection slipped back, once, then again.
pairs.hanzi: 检查被往后排，一次，又一次。

pairs.target: dìèrnián sònglái xù tíng de wénshū , tā zài chénglǐ hé guò jiù jìlù , yě qiān le . "
pairs.english: The following year an extension order arrived; she checked the old records in the city and signed that too.
pairs.hanzi:
第二年送来续停的文书，她在城里核过旧记录，也签了。
“

pairs.target: nǐ yòu qù le ? " " nàcì méiyǒu . "
pairs.english: “You went again?” “Not that time.”
pairs.hanzi:
你又去了？”
“那次没有。”

pairs.target: wūlǐ jìng le piànkè .
pairs.english: The room went quiet for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里静了片刻。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe tā de shǒu , xiǎngqǐ tā měi huí jiào zìjǐ dào xiànchǎng kàn , bié zhī xìn huà zài zhǐ shàng de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at her hands, remembering all the times she had told him to check the site rather than trust drawings alone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着她的手，想起她每回叫自己到现场看，别只信画在纸上的东西。

pairs.target: zhège niàntou tài qīngchǔ , tā méifǎ jiǎzhuāng méiyǒu . "
pairs.english: The thought was too clear; he couldn't pretend it wasn't there.
pairs.hanzi:
这个念头太清楚，他没法假装没有。
“

pairs.target: nà nǐ zěnme zhīdào hái dé guān ? "
pairs.english: “Then how did you know it still had to stay closed?”
pairs.hanzi: 那你怎么知道还得关？”

pairs.target: nài lěi táiqǐ yǎnjīng . " wǒ méiyǒu néng zhèngmíng tā yǐjīng ānquán de jìlù .
pairs.english: Nerai raised her eyes. “I had no record proving it was safe.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾抬起眼睛。“我没有能证明它已经安全的记录。

pairs.target: nǐ xiǎng ràng wǒ píng biérén cuī dé jí , jiù fàng chē guòqù ? "
pairs.english: You wanted me to let carts through just because people were pressing?”
pairs.hanzi: 你想让我凭别人催得急，就放车过去？”

pairs.target: tā de shēngyīn bǐ gāngcái yìng .
pairs.english: Her voice had hardened.
pairs.hanzi: 她的声音比刚才硬。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiānbǎng yì jǐn , liǎn yě hóng qǐlái .
pairs.english: Tavi's shoulders tightened and his face flushed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维肩膀一紧，脸也红起来。

pairs.target: tā bìng búshì xiǎng ràng rén diàoxiàqù , kě yì shuō chūkǒu , wèntí hǎoxiàng jiù zhī shèngxià zhège . "
pairs.english: He didn't want anyone to fall, but spoken aloud, that seemed to become the only question.
pairs.hanzi:
他并不是想让人掉下去，可一说出口，问题好像就只剩下这个。
“

pairs.target: búshì . " tā shuō , " wǒ wèn de shì , nǐ wèishénme búzài qù kàn . "
pairs.english: “No,” he said. “I'm asking why you didn't go back to look.”
pairs.hanzi: 不是。”他说，“我问的是，你为什么不再去看。”

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu jiē huà .
pairs.english: Nerai said nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有接话。

pairs.target: zhuōbiān yǒu yìdī jiù mò , bèi zhǐ yāchū bàngè yuán ,
pairs.english: An old ink drop at the table's edge had been pressed into a semicircle by paper.
pairs.hanzi: 桌边有一滴旧墨，被纸压出半个圆，

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīng zhe tā , xīnlǐ yòu pà yòu qì .
pairs.english: Tavi stared at it, frightened and angry.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维盯着它，心里又怕又气。

pairs.target: tā kào tā cái jìn le zhèlǐ , xuéhuì zhèxiē yǐqián lián míngzì dōu bù zhīdào de dōngxī .
pairs.english: She was the reason he was here, learning things he'd never even known the names of.
pairs.hanzi: 他靠她才进了这里，学会这些以前连名字都不知道的东西。

pairs.target: kě tā zuòzài zhèlǐ , yě bùnéng ràng běipō de táijiē shǎo yījí .
pairs.english: But her sitting here couldn't remove a single step from the north slope.
pairs.hanzi: 可她坐在这里，也不能让北坡的台阶少一级。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhōngyú bǎ nà fèn xù tíng chāojiàn fān dào qiānmíng de yímiàn . "
pairs.english: Nerai finally turned the extension copy to its signature side.
pairs.hanzi:
奈蕾终于把那份续停抄件翻到签名的一面。
“

pairs.target: zhè yí wèn shì duì de . " tā shuō , "
pairs.english: “That is a fair question,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: 这一问是对的。”她说，“

pairs.target: wǒ nàshí bǎ ' méiyǒu xīn jìlù ' dàngchéng le kěyǐ zài děng de lǐyóu .
pairs.english: “I treated 'no new record' as a reason to wait longer.
pairs.hanzi: 我那时把‘没有新记录’当成了可以再等的理由。

pairs.target: duì wǒ shì yìzhāng dàibàn , duì zhù zài nàlǐ de rén búshì . "
pairs.english: To me it was a pending task. Not to those living there.”
pairs.hanzi: 对我是一张待办，对住在那里的人不是。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěn màn , bìng méiyǒu yīncǐ biànde qīngsōng .
pairs.english: She spoke slowly, no easier for having said it.
pairs.hanzi: 她说得很慢，并没有因此变得轻松。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn xiànzài wèishénme yòu fānchūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi asked why she was looking at it again now.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问现在为什么又翻出来。

pairs.target: nài lěi cóng juàntú xiàmiàn chōuchū yìfēng liánmíngxìn .
pairs.english: Nerai took a jointly signed letter from beneath the rolled maps.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾从卷图下面抽出一封联名信。

pairs.target: jǐhù rén qǐngqiú xiānchá kàoshān de zhǎi biān , shìfǒu néng zhī ràng bùxíng de rén guò , bùtōng huòchē .
pairs.english: Several households asked for an inspection of the narrow mountainside edge first: could pedestrians pass, even without freight carts?
pairs.hanzi: 几户人请求先查靠山的窄边，是否能只让步行的人过，不通货车。

pairs.target: tāmen zìjǐ jì le yǔ hòu nǎ kuài lù bǎn huì xiǎng , hái huà chū yígè bèi jiù tú lòudiào de páishuǐkǒu . "
pairs.english: They had noted which planks creaked after rain and drawn a drain the old map had missed.
pairs.hanzi:
他们自己记了雨后哪块路板会响，还画出一个被旧图漏掉的排水口。
“

pairs.target: zhèxiē shì tāmen zuìjìn sònglái de ? " "
pairs.english: “They sent these recently?”
pairs.hanzi:
这些是他们最近送来的？”
“

pairs.target: shànggèyuè . yǒu yífèn gèng zǎo , liúzài lìng yígè jiēshōu chù , méi gēn dào wǒ zhèběn cèzǐ lǐ . "
pairs.english: “Last month. There's an earlier one left at another receiving office. It never reached this file.”
pairs.hanzi: 上个月。有一份更早，留在另一个接收处，没跟到我这本册子里。”

pairs.target: tā tíng le tíng , yòu shuō : " zhè bùnéng dōu suàn zài biérén tóushàng .
pairs.english: After a pause she added, “That can't all be blamed on others.
pairs.hanzi: 她停了停，又说：“这不能都算在别人头上。

pairs.target: wǒ qiānguò xù tíng , jiù gāi zhuī zhe wèn . "
pairs.english: I signed the extension. I should have kept asking.”
pairs.hanzi: 我签过续停，就该追着问。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xìn jiēguò lái , xiān kànjiàn jǐzhǒng bù yíyàng de zì .
pairs.english: Tavi took the letter and first noticed the different hands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把信接过来，先看见几种不一样的字。

pairs.target: yǒu de míngzì xiàng yìgēn gēn hěn zhí de mùgùn , zuìhòu yígè rén zhī huà le jìhào , pángbiān yǒurén xiěmíng shì dài jì .
pairs.english: Some names looked like straight sticks; the last person had made only a mark, with a note beside it saying someone had written on their behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 有的名字像一根根很直的木棍，最后一个人只画了记号，旁边有人写明是代记。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ ménfáng wài nàxiē kàn bái pái de xuéshēng , hūrán bù zhīdào zìjǐ hái xiǎng buxiǎng tīng tāmen wèn kèhén . "
pairs.english: He remembered the students looking at the white tally outside the gatehouse and suddenly wasn't sure he still wanted to hear their questions about the notches.
pairs.hanzi:
他想起门房外那些看白牌的学生，忽然不知道自己还想不想听他们问刻痕。
“

pairs.target: nǐ huì bǎ lù kāi le ma ? " "
pairs.english: “Will you open the road?”
pairs.hanzi:
你会把路开了吗？”
“

pairs.target: wǒhuì zài qù . néng bunéng kāi , dé cháwán cái shuō .
pairs.english: “I'll go back. Whether it can open comes after inspection.
pairs.hanzi: 我会再去。能不能开，得查完才说。

pairs.target: xiànzài dāying nǐ , gēn dāngnián ràng tāmen yìzhí děng yíyàng bú fùzé . "
pairs.english: Promising you now would be as irresponsible as making them wait all those years.”
pairs.hanzi: 现在答应你，跟当年让他们一直等一样不负责。”

pairs.target: zhè jù huà yòu xiàng píngshí de nài lěi le , tǎ wéi què méiyǒu xiàng píngshí nàyàng diǎntóu .
pairs.english: That sounded like the usual Nerai, but Tavi didn't nod as he usually did.
pairs.hanzi: 这句话又像平时的奈蕾了，塔维却没有像平时那样点头。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liánmíngxìn fàngzài tú páng , shuō zhèxiē rén bú zài suǒyǐn kǎ shàng ,
pairs.english: He placed the petition beside the map, saying these people weren't on the index cards;
pairs.hanzi: 他把联名信放在图旁，说这些人不在索引卡上，

pairs.target: àn gāngcái de páifǎ , zhǎo lù zhī huì zhǎodào tíng xíng lìng .
pairs.english: with their earlier sorting method, anyone searching for the road would find only the closure order.
pairs.hanzi: 按刚才的排法，找路只会找到停行令。

pairs.target: nài lěi dītóu kàn tā fàng zhǐ de wèizhì , guò le yíhuìer , nálái yìzhāng kōng kǎ . "
pairs.english: Nerai looked down at where he'd placed the letter; after a while she fetched a blank card.
pairs.hanzi:
奈蕾低头看他放纸的位置，过了一会儿，拿来一张空卡。
“

pairs.target: bǎ láixìn chù yě jì jìnqù . yuánjiàn réng guī zài zhè fēngxìn xià . "
pairs.english: “Record where the letters came from too. Keep the originals filed under this letter.”
pairs.hanzi: 把来信处也记进去。原件仍归在这封信下。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò bǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi took the pen.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过笔。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu tì tā bǎ yǔqì lǐ de píjuàn mǒdiào , yě méiyǒu zài zhēng yíjù fēi yào ràng tā dītóu dehuà .
pairs.english: He neither tried to erase the tiredness in her voice nor argued for another word that would force her head down.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有替她把语气里的疲倦抹掉，也没有再争一句非要让她低头的话。

pairs.target: tā bǎ jǐgè jiēshōu chù hé rìqī chāo quán , chāo dào zuìhòu , cái wèn nà fèn gèng zǎo de xìn néng bunéng yě bǔ lái .
pairs.english: He copied all the receiving offices and dates, then finally asked whether the earlier letter could be retrieved too.
pairs.hanzi: 他把几个接收处和日期抄全，抄到最后，才问那份更早的信能不能也补来。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō néng , huì qù yào .
pairs.english: Nerai said yes, she'd ask for it.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说能，会去要。

pairs.target: wūwài de fàn shēng jiànjiàn sàn le .
pairs.english: The supper calls outside slowly faded.
pairs.hanzi: 屋外的饭声渐渐散了。

pairs.target: tāmen shōu zhǐ shí , tǎ wéi zhàojiù bāng tā juàn hǎo tú , què méi zài shēnshǒu názǒu quánbù .
pairs.english: As they packed up, Tavi helped her roll the maps as usual, but didn't reach to take them all.
pairs.hanzi: 他们收纸时，塔维照旧帮她卷好图，却没再伸手拿走全部。

pairs.target: tā bào zhe fēngěi zìjǐ de nà liǎngjuàn , děng tā suǒmén .
pairs.english: Holding the two rolls assigned to him, he waited while she locked the door.
pairs.hanzi: 他抱着分给自己的那两卷，等她锁门。

pairs.target: xiàlóu shí liǎnggè rén gé zhe yījí táijiē , shuí yě méi jí zhe bǎ nà diǎn jùlí tián shàng .
pairs.english: They went downstairs a step apart, neither hurrying to close the distance.
pairs.hanzi: 下楼时两个人隔着一级台阶，谁也没急着把那点距离填上。
